latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of auto-improver: an autonomous AI agent that learns and optimizes itself through 17-minute execution loops.
- Introduces confidence scoring with a six-dimensional evaluation and time decay model.
- Features advanced pattern extraction (supports 8 types) and flexible aggregation (Skill/Command/Agent).
- Includes use-case examples, FAQ, pricing tiers, and quickstart commands.
- Ensures data privacy with local encryption and supports private deployment for enterprise users.
